home.heroSubtitle: GARVI (Gujarat Academic Ratings Visualization for Improvement) is the official state analytics & institutional benchmarking engine powering GSIRF 2026 for 470+ universities and colleges.
home.toolkitSubtitle: Comprehensive multi-dimensional intelligence built for Gujarat Vice-Chancellors, Principals, and Education Administrators.
home.pillarsTitle: The 4 Core Pillars of GSIRF Rating
home.pillarsSubtitle: Gujarat State Institutional Rating Framework evaluates academic excellence across four internationally benchmarked core dimensions.
home.ctaSubtitle: Access institutional rankings, predictive simulations, and accreditation gap reports directly.

modules.analyticsDesc: Statewide interactive dashboards, star distribution, and pillar performance metrics powered by PowerBI.
modules.benchmarkingDesc: Head-to-head peer comparisons across Teaching, Research, Placements, and Infrastructure metrics.
modules.simulatorDesc: Predict your star rating by adjusting faculty counts, PhD staff, research publications, and lab budgets in real time.
modules.adminDesc: State-level oversight, institutional submission tracking, audit log, and instant CSV verification export.

pillars.tlrDesc: Faculty-student ratio, faculty with PhD, financial resource utilization, and modern lab facilities.
pillars.rpDesc: Scopus/WoS publications, citations, IPR patents granted, and sponsored research funding.
pillars.goDesc: Median placement salary, percentage of students placed, higher education progression, and university exams.
pillars.oiDesc: Gender diversity ratio, students from outside Gujarat, economically/socially challenged student scholarships.
